name: Stockdata.org
tagline: Simple equities and news market-data API for stocks and financial headlines
description: Stockdata.org is a market-data API offering real-time and historical stock prices, company data, and financial news for equities. It targets developers who need a straightforward REST interface for tickers, quotes, and news without a heavy institutional data stack. A free developer plan is available with documented request limits.

auth.details: API key via query parameter api_token (or Authorization header depending on plan docs); self-serve signup.

use_cases: get latest stock quote for a ticker
fetch historical EOD prices for a symbol
search recent financial news for a company
look up basic company/profile metadata for a stock
